name: throughline
description: Throughline Wave A1 monorepo foundation for active, trusted organizational memory.

scripts.test:foundation: node --import tsx scripts/require-foundation-test-env.ts && pnpm test:security && pnpm --filter @throughline/db exec vitest run src/foundation-security.spec.ts src/worker-transaction.postgres.spec.ts --poolOptions.threads.singleThread --no-file-parallelism && pnpm --filter @throughline/authorization exec vitest run src/authorization-service.spec.ts --poolOptions.threads.singleThread --no-file-parallelism && AUTH_ADAPTER=dev NODE_ENV=test pnpm --filter @throughline/api exec vitest run src/foundation-proof/foundation-proof.e2e.spec.ts src/foundation-proof/foundation-real-chain.integration.spec.ts src/foundation-proof/opentelemetry-continuity.integration.spec.ts --poolOptions.threads.singleThread --no-file-parallelism && pnpm --filter @throughline/outbox-relay exec vitest run src/relay.integration.spec.ts --poolOptions.threads.singleThread --no-file-parallelism && pnpm --filter @throughline/agent-worker exec vitest run src/worker-context.spec.ts src/runtime-config.spec.ts --poolOptions.threads.singleThread --no-file-parallelism && pnpm --filter @throughline/agent-worker test:foundation-real && pnpm exec vitest run tests/integration/foundation-s3-marker.integration.spec.ts --poolOptions.threads.singleThread --no-file-parallelism
scripts.test:b1-0: node --import tsx scripts/require-b1-0-test-env.ts && pnpm test:foundation && pnpm --filter @throughline/testing exec vitest run src/b1-0-test-config.spec.ts src/b1-0-architecture.spec.ts --poolOptions.threads.singleThread --no-file-parallelism && pnpm --filter @throughline/core-types exec vitest run src/domain-notification.spec.ts --poolOptions.threads.singleThread --no-file-parallelism && B1_0_AUTHORITATIVE_GATE=1 NODE_ENV=test pnpm --filter @throughline/db exec vitest run src/b1-0-migration.spec.ts src/audit-safe-detail.spec.ts src/product-domain-repositories.spec.ts src/product-outbox-architecture.spec.ts src/b1-0-product-domain.postgres.spec.ts --poolOptions.threads.singleThread --no-file-parallelism && B1_0_AUTHORITATIVE_GATE=1 pnpm --filter @throughline/authorization exec vitest run src/authorization-service.spec.ts --poolOptions.threads.singleThread --no-file-parallelism && B1_0_AUTHORITATIVE_GATE=1 NODE_ENV=test pnpm --filter @throughline/outbox-relay exec vitest run src/product-main.spec.ts src/product-relay.spec.ts src/product-relay.integration.spec.ts --poolOptions.threads.singleThread --no-file-parallelism
